args.name: header.json
args.section_json:
{
  "conventions": [
    "All TypeScript and TSX files use Prettier formatting with 2-space indentation, single quotes, and trailing commas.",
    "New files must start with the standard Backstage Apache 2.0 license header (Copyright 2026 The Backstage Authors).",
    "Avoid adding required members to public interfaces implemented outside scope (such as RouteResolutionApi implemented by CompatRouteResolutionApi in @backstage/core-compat-api).",
    "React hooks in @backstage/frontend-plugin-api must support React 17 and React 18 using standard React hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo).",
    "Tests use @testing-library/react with Jest and must avoid triggering un-acted state updates or infinite render loops."
  ],
  "decisions": [
    {
      "topic": "Notifying useRouteRef when route resolution is re-initialized at app finalization",
      "choice": "Add a subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void method on RouteResolutionApiProxy in @backstage/frontend-app-api that notifies registered listeners whenever initialize() replaces the underlying RouteResolver delegate, and have useRouteRef in @backstage/frontend-plugin-api subscribe to routeResolutionApi.subscribe?.(...) via useEffect to increment a local state counter included in its useMemo dependency array.",
      "rejected": [
        "Adding a required subscribe method to the public RouteResolutionApi interface",
        "Creating a separate public lifecycle APIRef in @backstage/frontend-plugin-api",
        "Clearing and remounting app/root.elements instances during clearFinalizationBoundaryInstances"
      ],
      "reason": "Adding a required member to RouteResolutionApi breaks CompatRouteResolutionApi in @backstage/core-compat-api (outside scope); clearing app/root.elements would unmount persistent root elements across sign-in; an optional/duck-typed subscribe method on RouteResolutionApiProxy keeps public API reports unchanged and directly invalidates useRouteRef memoization and triggers re-render on final

text: Both `header.json` and the updated `units-001.json` have been handed in and accepted by `plan-lint`.
